g.text: # 1. Set up a governed repo: config, AGENTS.md, hooks, CI (offline)
StreamSnow setup: every answer from flags; everything else is
written as an editable, commented default.
default snow connection 'kchalmers_ai' is for another account, so connection_name is
sources not checked live (no snow connection named 'acme-analytics' on this machine yet);
1. Claude Code users, from this directory:
claude plugin marketplace add --scope project kyle-chalmers/streamsnow
then /onboard in a Claude Code session here
(CLI only? skip this step. Codex: streamsnow agent-skills install --agent codex)
… (snow connection, pre-commit and deploy-setup tips trimmed)
The starter files are placeholders: queries/example_metric.sql, its entry in sql_review/index.yaml
and pages/overview.py (sample numbers). Replace them with your real pages and queries (/build-app
does this in its build phase); validate-app FAILS while any file still reads
.streamlit/ AGENTS.md branding.py pages/ pyproject.toml queries/ review.py snowflake.yml
# 3. The ship gate: deterministic PASS/FAIL (starter placeholders must go)
